lens: Skeptic: every detail is assumed wrong until a real photo shows it right. Official ANA photos (y_47300-07) decide colours and finishes; SANspotter NH7 2023 and fr57325 photos decide geometry. Measurements use python3 PIL/numpy on /tmp/claude-0/r8 (q15-q18 and studio) against ref/ana and ref/web/econ, with Otsu light fraction, mean hex, R/B and G/B, L p10/p50/p90, and blob statistics with the render resampled to the photo's pixels per back width. Scratch crops are in /tmp/claude-0/raterA8. Lighting and QA camera placement are excluded from the score (q15 still looks down about 24 deg).

priorIssues.issue: w7a-1 / w7b-2 dash mosaic too dark and violet, with blurred dashes
priorIssues.evidence: q15 seat 2 mosaic is now #29355d, L50 55, R/B 0.44, G/B 0.57 (was #1e2a62, L50 41, 0.31/0.44). y_47306 right seat: #394978, L50 73, 0.48/0.61. The mosaic/tick luminance ratio in the same frame is 0.71 in the render against 0.79 in y_47306. The dashes are still dim and blue: the Otsu light-cluster mean is #3d4d78 against #6f7fae, and p90/p50 is 1.68 against 2.00. At row distance the 1 px (0.8 mm) dashes mip down into blue speckle, so the photo's blocks of grey-white horizontal dashes never form (r15_backs.png against p06_right.png).

priorIssues.issue: w7a-2 / w7b-3 diamond is a regular grid of small figures
priorIssues.evidence: Sizes are now mixed and some sites are dropped, but the figures are still solid, smooth-edged pale diamonds separated by a continuous dark lattice: a wallpaper look (r_dia.png against p02_dia.png). The Otsu light fraction is 0.48 (x_pillow) and 0.43 (q15), against 0.11 (y_47302 middle seat) and 0.15 (y_47306 left seat). In the photos the diamonds are a low-contrast mid-tone mottle made of ragged, lacy, broken stepped shapes, and the brightest pixels are sparse flecks inside them. Render figures are about 0.06 m across (q15 seat 1, 28-32 px on a 215 px / 0.44 m back); the photo figures look about 0.08-0.10 m.

priorIssues.issue: w7a-3 back rises only about 3 cm above the headrest/cover
priorIssues.evidence: e4_head seat 2: back top at 128 px, cover top at 163 px, back width 255 px for 0.44 m, so about 0.06 m. y_47306 measures 0.053-0.073 m. In q17 no slate fold bar shows above the hoods any more.

priorIssues.issue: w7a-4 / w7b-5 pans copy the back fabric
priorIssues.evidence: e1/e7: both fleck backs sit on tick pans, and the diamond back sits on a mosaic/tick pan. econPan() at 09a_econ.js:11 uses its own hash.

priorIssues.issue: w7a-5 petal fleck too dense and too fine
priorIssues.evidence: With q15 seat 4 resampled to y_47300's 125 px per back width: 832 blobs per bw^2, cover 0.30, median 49.6 mm2. y_47300 seats 2 and 4: 734-749 blobs, cover 0.24, median 49.6 mm2. r7 measured 903 blobs and cover 0.29. The petals are still about 12 % too many with about 25 % too much cover, and the ground is too dark (see new issue w8a-4).

priorIssues.issue: w7a-6 / w7b-4 headrest cover navy, not slate

priorIssues.evidence: e7 belt: dark part #457fb7, G/B 0.74, R/B 0.48. y_47303 right belt: #38629b, G/B 0.63, R/B 0.37. It is now teal-blue, perhaps slightly too light and cyan under studio light (low; not raised).

priorIssues.issue: w7a-8 / w7b-6 pillow lacks the bow-tie pinch
priorIssues.evidence: x_pillow / e7: still a rounded-rectangle cushion with soft round corners. The top edge is only faintly concave and the corners do not pinch or flare. y_47300: all four pillows have concave sides and pointed corners.

priorIssues.issue: w7a-9 / w7b-1 headrest pad invisible / wings not proud
priorIssues.evidence: e4_head: round wing bolsters stand clearly forward of the recessed cover on both sides, with a visible shadow line. Wing width is about 0.24 of the back width (photo y_47306: 0.10-0.15 visible obliquely). The pad now reads as a U-shaped cushion in q15 and q16.

priorIssues.issue: w7a-10 / w7b-9 pocket net opaque, label invisible
priorIssues.evidence: e6: the net is now a black square grid over a dark panel. It reads as a rigid radiator grille, not the two soft, sagging pouches of sans 20, which have ruched scalloped elastic tops and a central dark strap. The tray label now shows a border and 3 small red/black squares (e5).
x_backtop: a small off-white knob sits near the top of the hood side face.

priorIssues.issue: w7a-12 tick about 25 % too dark and violet
priorIssues.evidence: q15 seat 3 tick: #374570, L50 77, R/B 0.49, G/B 0.62, light fraction 0.46. y_47300 seat 3 in the same position: #36436c, L50 78, R/B 0.50, G/B 0.62, light 0.53.

priorIssues.issue: w7b-7 armrest is a straight box on a cylinder post
priorIssues.evidence: e7/e1: still a box arm with a separate rounded knuckle block at the rear (gRBox 0.05 at z -0.40, -20 deg) and a round-ended vertical post. y_47303 and fr57325 124108 show a long, slim, gently curved beam that tapers to a drooping nose, carried on a broad, sloping blade-like support. The colour also reads too white in studio (#e7e8e9 top) against y_47303 #b7bac0-#c1c4c9. SEATMAT.arm #c4c8cd is fine, so this is mostly lighting.

priorIssues.issue: w7b-8 cover reads as a rigid box; top fold bar behind the hood
priorIssues.evidence: The fold bar is gone from q17. In e4 the cover is still a flat, sharp-edged plate with uniform thickness. y_47306 shows a soft leatherette flap with a rolled top fold, slight sag and a stitched hem; the render has the hem band and logo.

priorIssues.issue: w7b-10 QA harness views do not match references
priorIssues.evidence: q15 still looks down (back tops near y 215 with the pillows cut at the frame bottom). y_47300 is near level and shows the pans and pillows. Not scored.

details.refs: y_47300 seats 1/3, y_47306 middle; q15 seat 3 matches mean, hue and light fraction. The render's columns are wavy, continuous threads, where the photo shows segmented rice-grain ticks in distinct columns.
y_47302 middle, y_47306 left: lacy, low-contrast ikat diamonds. The render has crisp solid figures on a dark lattice, with light fraction 0.48 against 0.11-0.15.
y_47300 seats 2/4: density and size now close. The ground is too dark and violet: #19234e against #22305b, R/B 0.39 against 0.44-0.45.
y_47306 right, y_47302 left: dashes too dim and blue (#3d4d78 against #6f7fae). It reads as speckle noise, not cell blocks of grey-white horizontal dashes.
y_47300 / y_47303: pans are now independent and the four fabrics alternate. The pad fabric mapping (diamond back with mosaic pad, mosaic back with diamond pad) agrees with y_47306.

y_47306, y_47302, y_47301: U-pad with proud bolsters, slate cover, hem and logo all present. The cover is still a rigid plate. Its proportions (0.65 x 0.56 of the back width) match y_47306 but not y_47300 (0.55 x 0.37, tucked inside the pad frame).
y_47300: no pinched corners. Colour #202a4c, R/B 0.42, against #242b4a, 0.49.
y_47303, fr57325 124108: boxy arm, rear knuckle and cylinder post.
y_47303: teal-blue webbing and grey buckle. Hue now right.
y_47300 / y_47303: cushion depth and crowned front are fine. Studio tick pans read pale and heathered (light #b5c1db), but q15 shows they are fine in cabin light.
y_47305, sans 13/15, fr57325 124234: shell shape, hood and knob are good, and the fold bar is gone.

y_47305 / sans 14: the bezel is flat jet black (#0c0b13). The photo's is a glossy dark-grey glass frame in a recessed grey shroud with a bright chamfer (photo bezel band #6b7180, partly reflection). The handset dock is a rectangle; the real one is a pill with rounded ends.
sans 20/23: the net reads as a rigid black grille, and the card shows only its purple header strip (the white pictogram panel standing above the flap is missing). The AC block is good.
y_47302/47304, e8: pedal footrests, spreader bars and red life-vest tabs are plausible. Footrest pedal shape is not verified against a deployed-footrest photo.

q15/q16 back rows: the cover/pad silhouette carries through, and the fabrics flatten to similar mid-blues. At distance, fleck seats are visibly darker than the others while the photo's rows read more uniform.

issues.title: Diamond fabric is still a crisp wallpaper of solid pale diamonds on a dark lattice, not a low-contrast broken ikat
issues.evidence: Otsu light fraction 0.48 (x_pillow) / 0.43 (q15) against 0.11 (y_47302) / 0.15 (y_47306). Render light/dark cluster means are #57618d / #2b3664. y_47302 has a mid-tone mottle with sparse bright flecks (#afb8cd over #384271). The figures are smooth-cornered, separated and about 0.06 m; the photo figures are lacy and ragged, about 0.08-0.10 m, and run tip to tip in chains (p02_dia.png against r_dia.png).
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py y_diamond(): set lift to about [1.6, 1.5, 1.3] and multiply the mask by a thresholded value-noise (e.g. m *= (_blur_wrap(rng.random((n,n)),1.5) > 0.45)) so each figure is about 55 % filled with ragged holes. Add sparse bright specks inside the figures (rng.random < 0.08, x3 lift) to restore p90. Raise hd to uniform(0.04, 0.055) so the tips overlap into chains, then re-run with --only y_diamond.

issues.title: Dash mosaic dashes vanish at row distance: 1 px dashes on a 256 px / 0.2 m tile mip into blue speckle
issues.evidence: q15 seat 2: light-cluster mean #3d4d78 against y_47306 #6f7fae, p90/p50 1.68 against 2.00, mosaic/tick luminance 0.71 against 0.79. The photo shows rectangular cells of long horizontal grey-white dashes, with clear dense and sparse blocks. The render reads as uniform noise (r15_backs.png).
issues.fix: y_mosaic(): use 2 px dash height (y1 = y0 + 2) with pitch 2.4*mm, or render the tile at 512 px (n = 2*S) so the dashes survive mip level 1. Desaturate the dashes (lift [6.5, 6.6, 5.6]). Widen the dense/sparse contrast (0.38 / 0.04) so the cell blocks read. Raise yFabricC base in 09_seats.js:19 slightly, from '#4a5576' to about '#4f5b7e'.

issues.title: Armrest still a box with a rear knuckle block and a round post
issues.evidence: e7 and e1 against y_47303 and fr57325 124108: the real arm is one slim, gently arched beam with a drooping nose on a broad, flat, sloping support blade. No separate knuckle block shows.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js:200: drop the gRBox(0.05,0.045,0.05) knuckle or merge it into the loft as a fifth SEC that tapers down at z -0.40. 09a_econ.js:209: replace the gRBox(0.036,0.23,0.06) post with a loftAt blade, 0.02 thick and 0.07 to 0.05 deep, raked about 15 deg forward.

issues.title: Petal-fleck ground too dark and violet; petals slightly over-covering
issues.evidence: q15 seat 4: dark cluster #19234e, L50 46, R/B 0.39, against y_47300 seats 2/4: #22305b / #1d2b51, L50 55-61, R/B 0.43-0.45. At matched scale the cover is 0.30 against 0.24 and the blob count 832 against 740 per bw^2.
issues.fix: 09_seats.js:20 yFabricD: '#424d70' -> about '#475476' (also yHead line 28). y_fleck(): stop at m.mean() < 0.09 and use a 8.0 mm rejection radius.

issues.title: Seat-pocket net reads as a rigid black grille; safety card shows only its header
issues.evidence: e6 against sans 20/23: two soft mesh pouches with ruched, scalloped elastic tops, a central dark strap and a light-grey leatherette flap above. The white pictogram card (about 0.21 x 0.12) stands above the flap with a purple 'B777-300' header. The render has a square-lattice slab and a thin purple strip.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js around lines 140-156: split the net into two bowed pouches (gLoft of 3 sections, mid section 0.012 proud) with a 0.025 dark strap between them. Raise the strand count to about 28 x 8 at 0.0015 thickness and add a ruched top tube. Extend the card quad to 0.12 tall with the white pictogram atlas region below the purple header.

issues.title: Pillow still has no bow-tie pinch
issues.evidence: x_pillow against y_47300 (all four): concave edges with pointed, slightly flared corners.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js:71-81: in the pillow section generator, pull the edge midpoints inward by about 0.025 (r *= 1 - 0.12*cos^2(2*theta) style), push the corners out to 0.95 of the half-extent, and thin the dome to zero at the corners.

issues.title: Screen bezel is flat jet black, not glossy dark-grey glass in a recessed shroud
issues.evidence: q18 bezel band #0c0b13 against y_47305 #6b7180 (part of that is reflection). y_47305 has a dark-grey glass frame, a darker recessed channel and a thin bright chamfer.
issues.fix: 09_seats.js:43 bezel: { c: '#22252c', r: 0.12 } (glossier and a touch lighter). Add a 0.006 lighter chamfer frame ('#8a8f99') round the bezel quad at 09a_econ.js:253.

issues.title: Headrest cover is a rigid flat plate
issues.evidence: e4 against y_47306: the real flap has a rolled top fold, slight belly and softened edges.
issues.fix: Loft the cover as 3 sections, with the middle bowed 0.006 forward and the edge radius raised to 0.006. Give the top fold a half-cylinder (r 0.012) instead of a box.

questionsForUser: y_47306 right seat (mosaic back) shows a band of the diamond/argyle fabric across the back top above the pad, with a narrow vertical chevron ('leaf-arrow') strip at the centre. Is that a separate headrest-frame panel that every seat has (in its own fabric), or only some seats? No in-service photo shows the back top from the front clearly.

Headrest cover proportions differ between official photos: y_47306 shows a large flap folded over the top and hanging below the pad (0.65 x 0.56 of the back width, as modelled), while y_47300 shows smaller covers sitting inside the pad frame (0.55 x 0.37). Which configuration is standard in service?
Which side of the hood carries the coat-hook knob (aisle-facing on both outer seats per sans 22, but the centre-block seats are unconfirmed)?
Is the economy footrest (from row 31) a twin-pedal fold-down bar as modelled? No deployed-footrest photo is in ref/.
extraRefsSearched: No new downloads. I re-examined all 28 ref/web/econ photos as contact sheets (sans 12-43, fr57325 x6) and all 8 y_473xx official photos. The most useful were sans 20 and 23 (pocket, card, AC), sans 14 (handset dock), y_47302 middle seat (diamond close-up) and y_47306 (mosaic, tick, pad, cover).
